note: R6-PORT-01. In a git CHECKOUT the $Format: tokens above are LITERAL and this file carries no identity: tools/release/release_identity.py (and its TypeScript twin) detect the unexpanded placeholder and resolve the release commit from git, which is the authoritative source when .git exists. In a `git archive` materialisation the tokens are expanded by git at export time (see .gitattributes `export-subst`), so this file is the ONLY source identity present and the resolver uses it. For a signed release tarball or an installed package, `python3 tools/release/release_identity.py --generate --out <dir>` OVERWRITES this file with a fully-populated body plus an `identity_digest` over its canonical form; that digest is recorded in the release artifact manifest, so tampering with the identity file invalidates the artifact.
